shared_elements: schematic creature head(s) with prominent rounded eye
paired/repeated motifs set side by side
justification: The only real overlap is the presence of highly schematic creature heads with large rounded eyes, plus a general tendency to repeat similar motifs side by side (two heads in A, a row of arch-signs and stacked animals in B). Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A is a single sculpted two-headed bust-like form with no scene, while B is a multi-register relief combining a geometric zigzag band, abstract signs, profile quadrupeds and a bird, arranged in ordered horizontal and vertical fields.
